description: Provenance of the contract copies bundled with this jar. Two kinds of entry, on purpose: 'files' are frozen copies of FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification RELEASE tags (governed by selection rules V1-V4), and 'drafts' are unreleased development contracts read only through the rule V7 opt-in lane. Each entry records the source repository, the commit, the exact path, the SHA-256 of the bytes and the retrieval date; the family convention is that a copied tree is pinned by commit and digest together. CapabilityTest and DraftProvenanceTest re-compute every digest on every build, so a copy that drifts from its own provenance fails the build instead of quietly becoming someone else's bytes.
releaseAndBytesAreSeparateAxes: A release tag says which registry row a file answers to; a digest says which bytes it is. They are recorded apart because they do not coincide: releases v0.4.1 and v0.4.2 changed no contract, so they repeat the v0.4.0 bytes, and v0.6.0's fhr.json is the unchanged v0.5.0 bytes (FHR 2.1 did not move). The 'releases' map in schemas/bundled.json therefore points several releases at one frozen copy, and each copy is named once here.

identicalBytesAcrossTags.v0.4.1/v0.4.2 fhr|fhp|fhgff3: v0.4.0 same files (verified with cmp on 2026-11-14)

artifacts.role: the draft file-bound header contract (rules V7, C1-C3 of the FHT suite)

FHT.crossCheck: The pinned commit is the last commit that touched fht.json, and its blob was compared byte-for-byte with FHT-Specification origin/main (156bda63) on 2026-11-14: cmp clean, both sha256 59ad9641adcb0e5591045c2d894c066d1adc9984cca84c5ff6502f8dad88487e. The reference toolkit pins the same commit and digest (FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools bioheaders/schemas/bundled.json, its #154 re-pin), verified 2026-11-14. The contract bytes live in this jar; the vectors come from the suite revision above, and DraftHarness re-digests both against these values before reading a vector.
FHT.meaning: Unreleased development contract, readable only through the rule V7 opt-in lane and warned on for every record read that way. Not a released contract: no schemaVersion row in the shared schemas/versions.json, no w3id alias, no release tag, no support claim. Publication moves it out of the lane (FHT is scheduled as specification v0.7.0).

transport.note: FHGM records are not a file header. They ride inside an FHGFF3 header under one R15 extension key, so the lane needs two pinned files - the record contract and the transport overlay - and the file itself is still routed by its own released FHGFF3 citation under V1-V3. A records row without all four fields (transportFile, transportSha256, modelsKey, carrierFileKey) is refused at registry load.

artifacts.role: transport overlay (the suite's K1): released FHGFF3 1.1 identity plus the x-fhgm-models array

baseSchema.note: The draft suite records this released copy as the base its outcomes were observed against; it is byte-identical to the frozen v0.5.0 copy already in this jar (see 'files' above), which the suite's own development/conformance/provenance.json states with the same digest.

FHGM.crossCheck: Both blobs were compared against FHGM-Specification origin/main (52b07b7a) on 2026-11-14 and are identical to the pinned commit's. The suite's own development/conformance/provenance.json records the same two digests and the same base-schema digest, so the pins agree across repositories without either one trusting the other's prose.
FHGM.meaning: Unreleased development contracts for gene-model records, readable only through the rule V7 opt-in lane and warned on per record. Not a released contract and not a file-bound header type: no schemaVersion, no w3id alias, no shared registry row, no support claim. Publication is scheduled separately (specification v0.8.0).
